The hypothesis and expression concern a spread between 12-month changes of two variables, V04 (flow rate) and V06 (stock rate). It references earlier 3- and 6-month versions, but those are not among the numbered claims.

Checking the claims for a match:
- Claim 3 covers an interaction of flow-rate momentum with wage-level momentum. That is different from a V04 vs V06 spread.
- Claim 6 covers hours momentum restricted to the high-T regime, which does not match.
- Claim 7 covers an hours-versus-wage spread, which involves different variables.
- Claim 8 covers regime-gated features, and the expression is not regime-gated.

The hypothesis does not use or test any of the numbered claims, so this is a new construction.
